claims.assertion: Mari says ordinary manifestation requires focused action, while “super-manifesters” align their thoughts and vibration to desired outcomes and may bypass many practical steps.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She frames this as a spiritual model of reality.

claims.assertion: Mari says some incarnated beings retain memories of the astral and between-life state and guide others; she links release from reincarnation to self-forgiveness rather than external absolution.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She presents these as spiritual claims about souls and karma.

coverage_gaps: claims about self-forgiveness and toxic dynamics
